core:1.2:2.reason: covered by the §4-§6 units; nothing here beyond them

core:1.2:3.reason: fn 0 offers exactly the eight ops (endpoint, virtual_core OPS); checker declarations() requires them; the client sends nothing else to fn 0

core:1.2:4.reason: checker requires unit_id / transport / max_op_ms in fn 0 describe (identity, transport_declarations); client reads the first copy

core:1.2:5.reason: fn 0 and every listed fn carry ops; unset ops answered unknown_operation (endpoint offers)

core:1.2:6.reason: channels only when the probe has channels: checker takes it absent as 0 (declarations), bench declares it with pins

core:1.2:7.reason: notification rules checked only on interfaces that emit (subscription checkers run on selected fns)

core:2.1:1.reason: probe-side reads of open force take non-zero as true (virtual_core, endpoint); checkers require 0/1 only of what the probe sends (describe more); client reads more/locked/armed with bool()/not

core:2.1:2.reason: response text shown via message.shown (owner, firmware labels); config labels and unit_id reach the terminal only through repr or JSON escapes

core:2.2:1.reason: one TLV form; a len past the message end: request malformed (Take.tail, virtual_core.tail), answer broken (split_tlvs ShortPayload, checker tlvs)

core:2.2:2.reason: bit 7 critical in requests only; readers compare tags as received so a bit-7 copy in an answer is skipped (catalog.first_value, Unavailable._first); checker tlvs refuses bit 7 from a probe

core:2.2:3.reason: TLV number 0 malformed in requests (Take.tail, virtual_core.tail), broken in answers (split_tlvs, checker tlvs); unsupported 0x00 read as the fixed-part mark (Unsupported.tag)

core:2.2:4.reason: unsupported payload echoes the tag byte as received (Take.received/refuse, virtual_core Reject(11, tag), Unsupported.tag keeps bit 7)

core:2.2:5.reason: tags read per (fn, op) / describe fn / (fn, kind) context; the TLV request checker isolates four contexts

core:2.2:6.reason: repeating tags only where defined (Take.tail repeats=); others first copy

core:2.3:1.reason: counted containers everywhere: Reader.counted, sequences with a count in front

core:2.3:2.reason: fixed forms not extended: readers read the fixed part then TLVs (Reader.tail); checkers use fixed_then_tlvs

core:2.3:3.reason: count x element with no element length (scan rows, list rows, streams rows)

core:2.3:4.reason: answer fixed part then TLVs, unknown tags skipped, short answers ShortPayload, TLVs of another length not used (fixed in rounds 5-7, re-checked)

core:2.3:5.reason: events and data: fixed part then TLVs (capture.unpack_event rd.tail)

core:2.3:6.reason: client sets critical on attach reset / scan max_speed (riscv; test_conformance_host_critical_calls)

core:2.3:7.reason: unknown critical -> unsupported with tag, non-critical ignored (Take.tail/check, virtual_core.tail); restart checker TLV case

core:2.3:8.reason: implemented TLVs checked the same with or without bit 7 (Take.fixed/refuse, virtual_core owner)

core:2.3:9.reason: request TLV values not extended: a longer value is malformed (Take.fixed)

core:2.3:10.reason: first copy used, later copies validated (fixed in rounds 4-7, re-checked)

core:2.3:11.reason: short fixed part malformed (Take.take/bytes, virtual_core len(payload) < fixed)

core:2.3:12.reason: design rule; every variable sequence in code is count-prefixed

core:2.3:13.reason: design rule; no optional fixed-part field in code
